name: Warren County, IA
findings: Warren County has 182 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Warren County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do professional organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
